messages:
Lucy: Quick read — a few signals and asks for the week ahead. TL;DR: 1) Hosted latency hit is resolved, 2) Dedicated-v2 canary next week, 3) trial orgs default logs retention is changing. Details below.

Lucy: Metrics snapshot (7d): p95 generation latency 220ms (was 260ms), 99th errors 0.9% (target <1%), reserved capacity utilization 78%, MRR expansion +12% MoM from recent feature launches. Mini-deck: https://redwood.internal/weekly-deck/197211

Lucy: Incident recap: Fri evening we saw a cache-eviction bug that increased KV misses and spiked token generation cost for ~45m. Root cause appears to be a rolling kernel upgrade + stale cache invalidation race on some ASG hosts. Impact: elevated cost and slight tail-latency on chat flows. Mitigation: kernel rollback, hotfix, tightened autoscaling cooldowns. Full postmortem will be posted in #postmortems.

Lucy: Ops policy change: Effective next Monday, trial orgs will default to 30d ephemeral logs retention (previously unlimited for trials). This reduces exposure and aligns with enterprise defaults. If you manage trial programs and need exceptions, ping @Helen.

Lucy: Launch callouts: Dedicated-v2 is green for internal canary on Tue. Goals: ~2x throughput at the same p95, improved preemption handling. Natalie + Eng runtime will run canary 2–6pm PST. If you own integrations that target dedicated endpoints, validate heartbeat and retry logic.

Lucy: Asks (priority):
- Sanjay — tighten the SLA wording in the new contract draft; prefer specific metric + window.
- Helen — coordinate trial exceptions and draft comms for support.
- Natalie — flag anything in canary that requires rollback hooks.

Sanjay: Noted. I'll tighten SLA language and circulate by EOD Monday. Want specific phrasing like "p95 generation latency <= X ms" or broader "response time"?

Lucy: Use exact metric + window. Start with: "p95 generation latency <= 250ms over a 30d rolling window" and legal can adjust.

Helen: Will draft support note and update trial templates. Also starting an exceptions registry (who/how long). Sending to #support by tomorrow.

Natalie: Canary plan ready. Will post runbook in #eng-runtime at 09:30 Tue. Abort criteria: 5% degradation in p95 or any 500s > 0.5%.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: Dedicated-v2-canary scheduled 2026-03-24T14:00Z. Health checks: ok.

Sanjay: Small question — do we announce the trial policy change now or wait until the contract UI ships?

Lucy: Wait one week after canary unless customer-impacting. Prepare a short FAQ.

Natalie: Note — runtime found an edge case with prefix cache TTL and long-context sessions; patch incoming, low risk for dedicated, will include in canary.

Lucy: Two themes this week: make Dedicated-v2 smooth (ops + canary attention) and tighten operational defaults so we can scale without surprise cost. Q&A Wed 11am PT; calendar invite coming.

Helen: Support and success are queued for the Q&A.

Natalie: Will link monitoring dashboards in the invite.

Sanjay: Circling back after SLA update.

Lucy: Drop any blockers here or DM me. :rocket:
